physical.title: wrapper (?); shawl (?)
physical.summary: Woman's wrapper or shawl; composed of twelve narrow strips hand sewn together. Warp stripes in machine spun cotton: indigo-dyed on white cotton ikat and plain white; single orange-dyed cotton stripe at one side. Decorated with supplementary weft float patterns in coloured cotton. Decorative twined white cotton threads at both ends. Short warp thread fringes.

cultural.vision_reason: A hunter's cap with leather appliqué, claw charms, and sealed amulet pouches, attributed by the museum to the Baule. This is a wearable ritual/hunting garment consistent with Baule hunters' association regalia.

physical.title: cap; hunting equipment
physical.summary: Hunter's cap; made of coarse dark brown cotton with light brown cotton edge; cap has rounded top and two triangular flaps at each lower side. Front has geometric decoration in light brown cotton chain stitch; twisted leather thong decoration; 41 pairs of leopard (?) claw charms attached using leather, cotton and snake skin; five sealed leather pouches (charms?) with some remaining fur. Back is decorated with geometric light brown cotton stitching. Appliqué decoration.
